docs.text: How many Great Lakes could you fit in that pool?

I’m talking about like your average pool at the local gym that’s tiled and has the swimming lines on the bottom for laps and is chlorinated. These pools are like… I dunno, several feet deep, they might as well be clear great lakes.
So the Great Lakes become indoor pools? Can we convert Lake Winnebago to a hot tub?
there’s no public pools here. there’s beaches… like 40-45 minutes away on one of the great lakes. but nobody to go with. so… it’s just not going to happen.
how big is this pool? Lake Michigan? #TCMParty

Typical water surface elevations and comparative lake depths of the Great Lakes: Did you know that the Great Lakes hold enough freshwater to fill an Olympic-sized swimming pool for every person on Earth? brilliantmaps.com/great-lak...

I don't know if my locals schools still do this, they cut a lot because of money, but we had weeks of classes where they'd bus us to the pool (unless you already had 'x' level of proficiency). Being surrounded by the Great Lakes, it made sense... the level of chlorine in the pool was...burning.

#IAGLRtrivia ANSWER: It would take 2.65 billion Olympic pools worth of water to fill Lake Michigan, so a person would need ~10,000 years to stand there with a hose to fill up Lake Michigan vs ~2 hours for an Olympic pool. Join us next time for another #GreatLakes challenge.

How well do you know your #GreatLakes? We have Olympic fever, so let's mix it in with some large lake fun. How many Olympic swimming pools worth of water can Lake Michigan hold? Answer will be revealed at 4 PM ET. #IAGLRtrivia

We still have #Olympics fever. The #GreatLakes are pretty big, but just how big are they? Big enough that it would take Canadian gold medal winning swimmer Summer McIntosh almost 12 days to swim the entire length of lakes Superior, Huron, Erie, and Ontario combined.
